title: TableNG colors come from theme.components.table, not recomputed in styles.ts
answers: Why do table header/row/hover colors look inconsistent between classic and visual-refresh themes?
How should I change the Table's row-selected, row-hover, header, or border colors?
Where is the Table's color logic supposed to live?
body:
Symptom: table surface colors (header background, row hover, row-selected, borders) drift out of sync between light/dark/visual-refresh themes or need re-tuning magic numbers whenever a new theme is added.
Root cause: TableNG used to derive these colors itself in grafana-ui/src/components/Table/TableNG/styles.ts:getGridStyles with ad-hoc math (emphasize on background.primary/canvas, darken/lighten of theme.colors.warning.main, a hand-picked HEADER_BACKGROUND_EMPHASIS constant).
Fix pattern: read base colors from theme.components.table (headerBackground, border, rowHoverBackground, rowSelectedBackground) and only derive *dependent* states locally: selected-row hover via theme.colors.emphasize(table.rowSelectedBackground, 0.05), header divider via colorManipulator.onBackground(theme.colors.secondary.shade, headerBackgroundColor), focused-cell border via theme.colors.action.selectedBorder.
Constraints: table.border and table.rowHoverBackground/rowSelectedBackground are already resolved solid colors, so they must be used directly (no onBackground compositing); only colors mixed from a semi-transparent input (secondary.shade) need onBackground. getGridStyles still gates the distinct header surface on the tableRefreshEnabled/table.refresh flag, independent of visualDesignRefresh.
applies: grafana-ui TableNG style derivation (getGridStyles) and any new table-adjacent UI reading theme colors
